description: Fetch the signature bundle for one signed document by signature assertion id (the signature_assertion_id inside the response value of a completed signature task). Returns the self-contained JSON an auditor can verify offline without trusting TaScan: the signed challenge preimage (v 2 also carries the typed name the signer entered, signer_typed_name), clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, public key, the user-verification and backup flags, the document SHA-256, task id, completion id and time. Check it with: npx tascan-verify --signature bundle.json [--doc the-document.pdf]. Contains no signed URL, phone number or email. Read tier, organization-scoped.

signature_assertion_id.description: signature_assertion_id (UUID) from the completion response value of a signature task

name: tascan_get_signature_bundle
